critical_code_review_comments: concerns.py POST /admin/subcategories validation (lines 326-330) correctly rejects empty/whitespace slug+name BEFORE the parent lookup, preventing zombie rows. Defensive, well-placed.
AdminProducts.js useEffect [editProduct?.__isNew, editProduct?.slug] (line 693) correctly re-runs the Promise.allSettled refetch on every modal open AND when slug changes — solid refetch contract.
AdminProducts.js line 1352: setEditProduct({...editProduct, category: e.target.value, subcategory: ''}) resets subcategory on category switch — no leakage. Identical to the NEW form (consistent UX).

AdminConcerns.js save() line 70-81: auto-derive lowercases name, kebab-cases via /[^a-z0-9]+/g, and PREFIXES with parent_category for subcategories — exactly matches the iter7 expectation 'lipstick-gloss-qa-auto-slug'. Smart UX — no more empty-slug zombies.

Minor: Add Product modal could use a [data-testid='new-product-niche'] attribute to make the same refetch path easier to test from outside (currently only the EDIT form has that exact testid). Not blocking — the same useEffect covers both.
